features.title: Admissions
features.description: Replace paper forms with configurable admission templates, parent magic-link onboarding, and one-click approval into student records and first invoices.

body.faq_description: Expert answers about DaycareMate, web development, AI, SEO and our process for childcare centres and businesses in Dubai, Abu Dhabi and across the UAE.

faqs.question: How does DaycareMate handle parent communication?
faqs.answer: DaycareMate includes a Family portal with a per-child activity feed, 1:1 messaging with teachers and admins, and broadcasts for closures and reminders. Teachers log meals, naps, learning and milestones in seconds. Photo attachments reach families through private storage, scoped to authorised parents only.

faqs.question: Can we combine a website, AI enquiries and DaycareMate?
faqs.answer: Yes. IGENTX delivered this for BloomWave Learning and Daycare in Abu Dhabi: bloomwave.ae for parent trust, a 24/7 AI enquiry assistant for after-hours lead capture, and DaycareMate for admissions and daily centre operations. One team can scope and roll out the full stack for your centre.

faqs.question: Does DaycareMate support billing and regional settings for UAE centres?
faqs.answer: Yes. Each DaycareMate deployment supports configurable currency, timezone and tax/VAT settings. Tax rates are frozen on each invoice at issue time, with per-line taxable flags and audit-logged billing runs. This helps UAE centres bill accurately while keeping parent statements clear.

faqs.question: Why choose IGENTX for UAE projects?
faqs.answer: IGENXT combines AI-accelerated delivery with deep UAE market experience. We build bilingual Arabic and English websites, integrate local payment gateways such as PayTabs and Telr, optimise for Dubai and Abu Dhabi local SEO, and measure success by leads and conversions. Our regional case studies include Moduluxe Group and BloomWave Learning and Daycare.

faqs.question: Why choose IGENTX over other web development companies?
faqs.answer: IGENXT combines AI-accelerated delivery with enterprise-grade engineering practices. Unlike template agencies, we build custom solutions on modern stacks like Next.js and React, optimised for performance, SEO and scalability from day one. Our team has deep UAE market experience with bilingual Arabic and English delivery, and we measure success by business outcomes: leads, conversions and operational efficiency, not just launch dates. You work with one team from strategy through launch and ongoing growth.

faqs.question: Do you work with startups and enterprises?
faqs.answer: Yes. For startups, we focus on fast MVP delivery, clear scope and foundations that scale. For enterprises, we emphasise architecture, security, integrations and phased rollouts. Our process adapts to your team size, budget and timeline, from a single landing page to multi-language platforms with headless CMS, ecommerce and AI automation. Contact us for a scoped proposal based on your goals.

faqs.question: Do you build bilingual Arabic and English websites?
faqs.answer: Yes. Bilingual delivery is core to our UAE work. We build RTL-ready Arabic pages alongside English content, with proper hreflang, multilingual SEO and culturally appropriate design. This helps businesses rank in both Arabic and English search and serve local and expatriate audiences effectively.

faqs.question: Do you integrate UAE payment gateways?
faqs.answer: Yes. We integrate PayTabs, Telr, Stripe, Checkout.com and other UAE-compliant payment gateways for ecommerce and custom applications. We advise on the right gateway based on your business model, currency requirements and checkout experience goals.

faqs.question: How long does website development take?
faqs.answer: Timeline depends on scope: a focused marketing site typically takes 2–4 weeks; larger corporate or ecommerce projects take 4–8 weeks. Factors include page count, integrations, multilingual requirements and content readiness. Our seven-step process includes discovery, strategy, design, development, QA, launch and ongoing growth, with clear milestones at each stage. We provide a realistic timeline after a brief discovery call.

faqs.question: How does your AI Customer Service Agent work?
faqs.answer: Our AI agent is trained on your website content, documents and FAQs using retrieval-augmented generation (RAG). It answers visitor questions instantly, qualifies leads and supports English and Arabic. Integration takes one line of code on any website. You control the knowledge base, review conversations and update content as your business evolves. It is deployable for subscribers and designed for accuracy, not generic chatbot responses.

faqs.question: Does the AI agent support Arabic and English?
faqs.answer: Yes. The agent supports multilingual conversations including Arabic (RTL) and English. This is essential for UAE businesses serving both local and expatriate audiences. Language detection and bilingual knowledge bases ensure visitors receive accurate responses in their preferred language, improving engagement and conversion for bilingual markets.

faqs.question: Do you work with startups in Dubai free zones?
faqs.answer: Yes. We work with startups and growing businesses across Dubai mainland and free zones. Our process focuses on fast MVP delivery, clear scope and foundations that scale as you grow. Contact us for a no-obligation consultation to discuss your goals and timeline.

faqs.question: Do you provide local SEO for Dubai and the UAE?
faqs.answer: Yes. We optimise Google Business Profile, local citations, Arabic and English landing pages, and location-specific schema markup. UAE local search requires bilingual strategy, mobile-first performance and culturally relevant content. We have experience helping businesses rank for Dubai, Abu Dhabi and emirate-specific queries while supporting international visibility.

faqs.question: What is DaycareMate and who is it for in the UAE?
faqs.answer: DaycareMate is IGENTX's childcare management platform for nurseries, preschools, childcare centres and early learning providers in the UAE and worldwide. It covers admissions, attendance, daily care logs, parent communication and billing in one system. Each centre gets a dedicated deployment. BloomWave Learning and Daycare in Abu Dhabi uses DaycareMate alongside their IGENTX-built website and AI enquiry assistant.

faqs.question: Do you work with centres and businesses outside Dubai?
faqs.answer: Yes. IGENTX serves clients across the UAE including Abu Dhabi, Sharjah, Ajman and Ras Al Khaimah, as well as international businesses. We deliver bilingual websites, local SEO, ecommerce, branding and centre software with remote collaboration and clear project milestones.

faqs.question: What is included in a typical UAE web project?
faqs.answer: A typical project includes discovery, UX and design, development on Next.js or your chosen stack, bilingual setup where needed, technical and on-page SEO, QA, launch support and optional ongoing optimisation. Scope varies by page count, integrations and content readiness. We provide a detailed proposal after a free consultation.

faqs.question: Can you migrate from WordPress to Next.js?
faqs.answer: Yes. We help UAE businesses migrate from WordPress and other CMS platforms to Next.js for better performance, security and scalability. Migrations include content transfer, URL redirects, SEO preservation and training. Contact us to assess your current site and migration timeline.
